name: ANAC 2024
description: This paper introduces the main research challenges and results of the 15th International Automated Negotiating Agents Competition (ANAC 2024). The main challenges addressed are learning the reservation value in bilateral negotiation and designing a factory agent employing concurrent negotiation in supply chain management. Additionally, it outlines the future research directions for the competition.
evaluation_method: competition ranking based on negotiation utility / payoff and task-specific game outcomes
reputation: Well-known in the automated negotiation community as a recurring competition that drives agent design and comparative evaluation.
notes: Competition-style benchmark with scenario-specific protocols rather than a single universal metric. Results depend heavily on opponent pool, negotiation protocol, and domain assumptions.
